value.title: 1992 French Maastricht Treaty referendum
value.snippet: A referendum on the Maastricht Treaty for the founding of the European Union was held in France on 20 September 1992. It was approved by 51% of the voters

value.title: 1992 Danish Maastricht Treaty referendum
value.snippet: A referendum on the Maastricht Treaty for the founding of the European Union was held in Denmark on 2 June 1992. The treaty was rejected by 50.7% of voters
